description: An Amazon S3 destination owned by the organization. The access key needs s3:PutObject on the bucket and prefix, and s3:DeleteObject for the connection check. Server-side encryption follows the bucket default.

bucket.description: The name of the S3 bucket.
bucket.title: bucket

prefix.description: The key prefix under which data is written. Allowed characters are letters, digits and !_.*'()/-; a leading slash or consecutive slashes are not allowed.
prefix.title: prefix

region.description: The AWS region code of the bucket, such as us-east-1.
region.title: region

secretAccessKey.description: The AWS secret access key. Write only: it is never returned. Omit it on update to keep the stored key.
secretAccessKey.title: secretAccessKey

title: DataSinkS3
